_noteW: Ebb and Flow: TotalDamage=BaseDamage+DamageAPRatio (the damage side of the heal/damage bounce; TotalHeal is the separate ally-heal calc, not modeled). WebSearch confirms Magic type, flat+AP-ratio shape. _noteE: Tidecaller's Blessing: TotalDamage=BaseDamage+DamageRatio(0.2 AP), empowers next 3 attacks/hits within 6s. WebSearch confirms 'bonus magic damage' on 'next 3 basic attacks or abilities'. Curated as bonusEffect trigger onHit (approximated as firing on every AA, same style as Diana P/Volibear P).
_noteR: Tidal Wave: TotalDamage=BaseDamage+StatByCoefficient(0.6, AP default). WebSearch confirms 'magic damage' with '(+60% of ability power)', matches BIN coefficient exactly. One hit per target swept.
